proposalGovernance.scope: Complete local OR11 snapshot preserves the full 2-second context and adds a shorter positive 1-second context under the same proposed stopped/opening-step identity. Actual OR11 dose, preparation, alternatives and clock are bound below. Earlier proposal/source/schema/app files remain unchanged; no approved canonical exercise or operational release is claimed.

description: Reach an actually controlled bilateral stop at the retained walking or gentle-jog approach. Hold for the selected full2 seconds or independently eligible shorter1 second, counted only after the genuine stop. Use exit-side small opening steps, lifting/replanting both feet so body/feet turn together into the early-announced2 m approximately45-degree ordinary walking exit. Finish with a separate quiet bilateral2-second hold, clear outward and take the segregated return with full recovery. Each assigned opportunity selects its own direction/context; first instruction, retention and actual completion remain distinct.

difficultyReview.rule: Do not copy immediate-cut, high-speed COD or single-leg terminal-hold scores. Nulls are permitted by schema; age and attendance are not exercise scores or participant clearance.

prerequisites: Actual controlled corresponding straight stop before any walking exit, with independently comfortable ordinary walking, bilateral standing and small lifting/replanting turns; no fixed-foot pivot or physical travel support.

Walking context preserves 2 m approach at comfortable about2/10, brake zone2.5–3 m and stop zone3–4 m. Gentle-jog context is D only and preserves 5 m approach at comfortable about3/10, brake zone6–8 m and stop zone8–10 m; actual controlled corresponding jog stopping is required for an exit.

whyLayer.whatItIs: A controlled straight stop, selected positive pause and early-announced ordinary opening-step walking exit.
whyLayer.whyItWorks: Authored coaching hypothesis: retaining the same controlled stop and walking action while conditionally shortening a deliberate pause makes a specific connection decision observable without introducing immediate cutting.
whyLayer.whyItGoesHere: OR11 uses actual OR03/07 or direct-equivalent context/side evidence and the most recent independent strength/response records; first1-second work and retained1-second work have different history gates.
whyLayer.programmingGuidance: Use counted individual instructional opportunities, complete reset and recovery before fatigue alters balance; retain familiar strength demands.
whyLayer.commonMisuse: Removing the stop while calling it a pause change, applying full-pause history to already repeatable shorter-pause retention, calling a narrow P2 check a complete exit pass, adding a separate E0 outside total, or restoring older strength load/count.

setup: Use the actual qualified OR-03 or direct-equivalent straight walking or gentle-jog stop context at its retained geometry and intent. Stand at the start with arms relaxed; the coach announces LEFT or RIGHT before release. No support is used during this locomotor sequence.

Walking context: 2 m approach, marked brake zone 2.5-3 m, bilateral stop zone 3-4 m. Gentle-jog context: 5 m approach, marked brake zone 6-8 m, bilateral stop zone 8-10 m. Begin braking before the marked brake zone using several comfortable controlled contacts; no single hard plant or fixed braking-foot/contact quota. Keep the original straight overrun protected to 15 m.
Coach demonstrates and announces the exact side, stop, pause, opening foot, exit finish and outside return before athlete release; no extra athlete walkthrough.
executionSteps: Reach a genuinely controlled bilateral stop, then hold the full selected1 or2 seconds before opening. Pause time starts after control, not on entry to a marker or a racing cue. Longer stabilization is recorded; do not rush the exit to satisfy a timer. Select a suitable held task or stop when the changed task does not fit.

Unload the exit-side foot and place a small opening step toward the announced approximately 45-degree exit. Lift and replant the other foot so feet and body turn together through small ordinary steps, then continue ordinary walking for the declared 2 m exit route including the opening steps. No twisting or pivoting on a planted foot, crossover, sidestep cut, jump, sprint or immediate plant-and-accelerate action.
After the2 m ordinary exit including opening steps, settle into quiet bilateral standing for a separate2-second terminal finish. This terminal finish is unchanged in either pre-exit pause context.

After the final hold, walk ordinarily outward to the matching outside one-way return. The allowance is at most 3.1 m of lateral clearing, verified from the actual pause position and exit endpoint. Return outside the active fan by the declared route, up to 35 m ordinary walking in a 40-second planning allowance plus 5 seconds to rejoin the rear holding bank. A slower participant delays the release or loses later opportunities; the clock is not a required walking pace.
coachingExecution.armRule: Relaxed natural arm motion during approach, turning, walking and clearance; no fixed arm position, speed contest, forceful arm drive or carried implement.
coachCues: Own the stop, then hold the selected pause.
Open with the exit-side foot; lift and replant the other foot.
Walk the known exit, settle on two feet, then clear outward.
athleteCues: Small steps turn me; no planted-foot twist.
commonFaults: opening before the genuine stop and full selected positive pause
stopSigns: Stop the affected task for symptoms, apprehension, participant request, restrictions, unsafe surface/traffic, loss of balance or unclear conduct.

Do not open/turn before a genuinely controlled corresponding bilateral stop and the full selected positive pause. A rushed or unstable finish is not a valid shorter-pause result. Record the actual pause and partial work; restore an independently suitable held task or stop without an added attempt.
End the affected exit for fixed-foot pivot, crossover, hard sidestep cut, immediate acceleration, wrong or late-announced direction, unsafe foot placement or uncontrolled terminal finish.
Actual longer instruction, braking, clearance or return delays/omits later work. Do not add an athlete walkthrough, substitute attempt, opposite-side debt, faster release or shorter recovery.
coachingExecution.countRule: Record all attempted opportunities, actual approach context, stop/pause, opening and walking steps, exit direction and final finish separately, including failed or partial actions. No planned flight or jump landing occurs. Actual braking and walking contacts are unknown until observed and remain null; zero planned jumping does not mean zero foot-contact or braking exposure.
